title: Error Session restore at startup: 2nd RDP tab fails with "RDP ActiveX control creation timed out after 10 seconds." (1.84.0 build 3752)
author: vansanper
body_snippet:
**What happens** (and what you expected instead):

After restarting the app (and when it is auto-started at logon), mRemoteNG reopens the previously open sessions. The first RDP tab connects fine. The second RDP tab never gets its ActiveX control and a modal error dialog appears: `RDP ActiveX control creation timed out after 10 seconds.` (screenshot attached). The tab stays stuck in "initializing" (log: `initialize_failed`, duration 326640 ms) until I click OK on the dialog, which then closes it...
